notes: Location Tracking Review page (/tracking): lists detected_locations with Pending / Tagged / Ignored tabs. Each row — tag as Job (link to existing job), Client (link to client), free-form label, Yard, Ignore, or Delete. Links from Settings → Passive Location Tracking card. Passive tracker now auto-detects native Capacitor builds and uses the background-geolocation plugin when present (true background tracking); falls back to foreground watchPosition in PWA mode. Info.plist updated with NSLocation*UsageDescription strings + UIBackgroundModes ['location','fetch'].
